implementation: Unblocked weapon.guardian-drone and routed its fire action to a falling mine-like deployment projectile.

Added a grounded stealth trap lifecycle: detect opposing unit inside the weapon radius, preserve that exact target id, end its active turn, rise for 0.25 seconds, then fire a guaranteed physical shot.
Added a target-bound SimProjectile path so the drone does not retarget or collide with terrain during its committed flight; a dead original target cancels the shot.
Mapped the projectile to the small mortira_shot sprite and made armed hostile drones hidden until trigger.

verification.format: git diff --check passed for the owned files
